messages:
ash: Quick async standup — kernel work / batching / KV cache / perf benches. Drop what you did, blockers, today.

maria: Finished kernel PR to prevent slot-steal on async path, merged to canary. Saw a small p95 uptick (~4ms) for short sequences after merge, digging into batching alignment. No blockers.

kevin: Pushed KV eviction heatmap to grafana, added tags for shard and tenant. Observed microburst spikes around 30s mark that align with eviction sweeps. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example/d/kv-heatmap/overview

sasha: Ran microbench for long seqs on rtx-a. Baseline (pre-patch) 82ms, post-patch 76ms for 8k seq. Command used: ```bash
./bench --model llm-8k --seq 8192 --concurrency 8 --warm 3
``` Results uploaded to s3://redwood-bench/2026/kv/bench-8192.json

ash: Blocker: CI flaky on microbatch tests — 2 failures in last 3 runs, looks like a race in slot assignment. @kevin can you attach latest logs? @taylor can you try to repro with `--race` locally?

taylor: Repro'ed one failure locally with `--race`. Stack trace points to kernel/scheduler.go:214. I'll open a PR adding a mutex guard and a unit test. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/492

dev-bot: deploy-bot: Canary deploy started for runtime-canary-2026-03-18 by @ash

maria: Quick rollback note — the KV prefetch tweak from yesterday increases memory ~12% under sustained load on canary. Rolling that tweak back now to keep canary stable.

kevin: Logs attached from the failing jobs: ```text
[2026-03-18T09:12:21Z] slot assign error: nil pointer deref
[2026-03-18T09:12:22Z] panic: runtime error: invalid memory address or nil pointer deref
[2026-03-18T09:12:22Z] goroutine 92 [running]:
``` Short snippet but shows the same path.

sasha: For batching heuristics, I'm proposing an opt-in config `batch.slot_align = true` (default false). Small tenants see throughput gains without raising median latency. I'll draft an RFC and include perf numbers.

ash: Today I'm going to triage CI flakes, run the full microburst suite across 3 GPU types, and coordinate the canary rollback/confirm. Ping this thread if you see the canary misbehave.

taylor: Note for artifacts: use `rg-run artifacts/<ci-id>` to fetch bench artifacts from the ci bucket. Helps repro locally. :thumbsup:

maria: No other blockers, doing canary smoke now.
